import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("/workspace/proteomics_data.xlsx", data_only=True)
ws = wb['Tumor vs Normal']

# Find ENO1
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    gene = row[2]  # gene column (3rd column, index 2)
    if gene and gene.strip().upper() == 'ENO1':
        protein = row[0]
        desc = row[1]
        normal = row[4]
        tumor = row[5]
        log2fc = row[8]
        pval = row[9]
        adjp = row[10]
        print(f"Found ENO1:")
        print(f"  Protein: {protein}")
        print(f"  Description: {desc}")
        print(f"  Normal: {normal}")
        print(f"  Tumor: {tumor}")
        print(f"  log2FC: {log2fc}")
        print(f"  p.value: {pval}")
        print(f"  adj.Pval: {adjp}")
        print(f"  log2FC rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(float(log2fc), 2)}")
        break
else:
    print("ENO1 not found!")
PYEOF

import bioblend.galaxy

api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

dataset_id = "f9cad7b01a4721358ca23968eabd4e86"
gi.datasets.download_dataset(dataset_id, file_path="/workspace/tumor_vs_normal.tsv", use_default_filename=False)
print("Downloaded successfully")

# Read and find ENO1
with open("/workspace/tumor_vs_normal.tsv") as f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split('\t')
    print(f"Header columns: {header}")
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        gene = cols[2] if len(cols) > 2 else ""
        if gene.strip().upper() == 'ENO1':
            print(f"\nFound ENO1 at line {i+2}:")
            for j, (h, v) in enumerate(zip(header, cols)):
                print(f"  {h}: {v}")
            log2fc = float(cols[8])
            print(f"\nlog2FC rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(log2fc, 2)}")
            break
    else:
        print("ENO1 not found!")
PYEOF

import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/proteomic_data.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wb['Tumor vs Normal']

# Find ENO1 in gene column (column C, index 2)
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    if row[2] and str(row[2]).strip() == 'ENO1':
        print(f'Found ENO1:')
        print(f'  protein: {row[0]}')
        print(f'  Description: {row[1]}')
        print(f'  gene: {row[2]}')
        print(f'  gene_id: {row[3]}')
        print(f'  Normal: {row[4]}')
        print(f'  Tumor: {row[5]}')
        print(f'  Ratio: {row[6]}')
        print(f'  FC: {row[7]}')
        print(f'  log2FC: {row[8]}')
        print(f'  p.value: {row[9]}')
        print(f'  adj.Pval: {row[10]}')
        print(f'  is_sig: {row[11]}')
        print(f'  compare: {row[12]}')
        break
else:
    # Try case-insensitive
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
        if row[2] and str(row[2]).strip().upper() == 'ENO1':
            print(f'Found ENO1 (case-insensitive):')
            print(f'  gene: {row[2]}')
            print(f'  log2FC: {row[8]}')
            break
    else:
        print('ENO1 not found in gene column')
"

import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/inputs/Proteomic_data .xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wb['Tumor vs Normal']

# Find ENO1 and get the exact cell value for log2FC
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
    gene = row[2].value  # gene column
    if gene and str(gene).strip().upper() == 'ENO1':
        log2fc_cell = row[8]  # log2FC column (0-indexed: col I)
        print(f"log2FC value: {log2fc_cell.value}")
        print(f"log2FC type: {type(log2fc_cell.value)}")
        print(f"log2FC number_format: {log2fc_cell.number_format}")
        
        # Also check Ratio for completeness
        ratio_cell = row[6]
        fc_cell = row[7]
        print(f"Ratio value: {ratio_cell.value} (type: {type(ratio_cell.value)})")
        print(f"FC value: {fc_cell.value} (type: {type(fc_cell.value)})")
        
        # Also print raw Normal and Tumor
        normal_cell = row[4]
        tumor_cell = row[5]
        print(f"Normal: {normal_cell.value}")
        print(f"Tumor: {tumor_cell.value}")
        
        # Compute log2FC from raw values
        ratio = tumor_cell.value / normal_cell.value
        import math
        computed_log2fc = math.log2(ratio)
        print(f"Computed ratio: {ratio}")
        print(f"Computed log2FC from raw values: {computed_log2fc:.10f}")
        print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(computed_log2fc, 2)}")
        break
